The recommended North-South track is via Waitawheta Hut, and the Waitawheta and Wharawhara valleys.

doubts: The start is matched to the Karangahake Gorge valley (T11) named in the text; the place 'Karangahake' (T10) is not used. The page says the walk can be shortened by entering or exiting at a side track, but names none, so no exit is recorded. Motutapere Hut is not in the example itinerary; its place is taken from 'the track between Motutapere Hut and Te Whare Okioki', so it is placed after Poupou Stream and before Te Whare Okioki. Hurunui Hut is on the main way because Day 7 (optional) runs from it to Kaimai Summit, but Day 6 may also end at Kaimai Summit. The Wharawhara valley is named in the recommended route but its place in the order is not stated, so it is not a via. Kauritatahi and Mangamuka huts are off the main track and have no packet entries. The old North-South track is an alternative route with no given start or end, so it is not a way; its ref T4 is the map track of that name.
